record.question: A person of Indian origin who has been nominated by United States President, Barack Obama as the next US Ambassador to India
record.explanation: Answer B: Richard Rahul Verma. Richard Rahul Verma was nominated by President Obama to be US Ambassador to India in September 2014. The US Senate's nomination record gives that exact full name, distinguishing the distractors. Reference: https://www.congress.gov/nomination/113th-congress/2074. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
